figures.caption: Fig. 2. The framework of the GAAL method. (a) Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning that only one modality’s learner is updated at each step. Uncertaintybased cross-modal gradient surgery utilizes gradients from cross-modal hard samples to guide the optimization of the shared classifier for the current modality. (b) Uncertainty-based Gradient Guidance that samples hard examples from another modality to provide cross-modal gradient guidance.
